items.title: Greek Key Sunburst Medallion DXF Panel for Bold Statement Doors

items.title: Perforated Diamond Dot DXF Panel for CNC Privacy Screens
items.description: Free to use, this piece has small diamond-shaped perforations arranged in gently curving rows across the entire panel, growing slightly larger toward the bottom edge. The subtle size gradient gives this otherwise simple dot pattern a quiet sense of movement and depth.
